title: Opening: spelling of Hirsch's name and recording date
summary: Hirsch spells his full name and explains the Mayer/Major/Mayor mix-up; interviewers give names and the date, 20 October 1987.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: And if there's some books that I can...
Speaking of right names, what's yours?

My right name that was given to me by my father and mother, first name, Godfrey, G-O-D-F-R-E-Y, the second name, Mayer, M-A-Y-O-R, the third name, Hirsch, capital H-I-R-S-C-H. The reason my middle name is Mayer and not Major is because when my grandfather, Mayor, Major came to this country, there was always a screw-up with the... What do you call that up there when they're coming in? Immigration? Yeah, from a foreign... Immigration. They pronounce the word Mayer, Major, like in Spanish, it's Mayor. Mayor. So they put the M-A-Y-O-R. So I do have some relatives by the name of Major, but I got the name of Mayor. Mayor. And my mother told Shep Morrison once, she says, you may be a mayor for four terms, but my son will always be a mayor. Mayor. What's your name? My name is Curtis Gerdy. Okay.
And I'm Dick Allen, and we're all picking up, and we're on the first reel. What's today's date?
Today is the 16th, I think. No, 20th. 20th? Yeah.
